effect.name: Film Grain
effect.description: Per-pixel noise over the picture. Breaks up flat areas, hides banding left by a small palette, and gives a still screen something to do.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: Animate this or the grain will not move.

parameter.name: Grain Size
parameter.description: Size of one grain in texels.

parameter.name: Shadows Only
parameter.description: On keeps the grain out of the highlights, which is how real film behaves and stops bright sprites looking dirty.

parameter.name: Coloured
parameter.description: On gives each channel its own noise. Off is monochrome grain, which is usually what you want on a limited palette.
